summary: Gorax provides a step-by-step guide on how to participate in the Eve of the Rift and Riftbound All-Star Night web event. Players must complete the in-game Fated Path quiz under Nightveil Standoff to pick a faction, with Gorax advising players to join The Dark Lady (Nightsworn Vanguard). Rewards from the web quiz can be sent to in-game mail via Prelude to Nightfall, and players can link their creators on the event webpage to gain draw entries for prizes.
tips: Complete the Fated Path quiz under Nightveil Standoff in the event menu; your quiz answers will not lock you out of choosing your preferred faction at the end.
Click Prelude to Nightfall inside the Eve of the Rift event screen to send your completed web quiz rewards directly to your mail.
Visit the Riftbound All-Star Night website to choose your God Envoy and Preacher to maximize your estimated draw count for lucky draw rewards.
title: How to JOIN the Faction War & Claim Web Event Legendary Hero! | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
